title: Your kobolds
intro: The team that works for you. Click a kobold to meet it.
supervisor: looks after the team and answers you, on every page

jobs.support: Answers your questions and takes your feedback
jobs.explorer: Thinks your ideas through and tells the story behind each one
jobs.maker: Doodle's helper: makes the versions you try
jobs.builder: Builds the cards you agreed on, one by one
jobs.tester: Uses your app as one of your personas and tells what went wrong
jobs.sorter: Sorts what comes in: bugs, requests and feedback

where.support: Every page, in the bar at the bottom
where.explorer: Explorations, on the board and in the talk beside it
where.builder: Factory, on the card it works on
